input_equation: fixed_sum: h + e; learned_mix: h + e + W concat(h,e), shared W initialized to zero, no bias
training_depth_policy_both: uniform integer 2 through 6, full gradients through all visited loops
primary_gate: All: learned_mix k6/own k4 BPB <=0.995; paired 95% CE(k6)-CE(k4) interval upper <0; learned_mix k4/fixed_sum k4 BPB <=1.01; learned_mix k6 BPB < fixed_sum k6 BPB.
allocation: Narrow additional R04 hypothesis test capped at two A100-hours including gates, separate from the unfunded generic 24-hour depth-ablation line. No authorization of a production run or the whole 300-hour illustrative plan is inferred. Recheck actual Colab availability before launch.
warm_start: Both arms start again from the original step4096 weights and loader cursor, with new optimizers and identical schedules; neither continues a completed step512 adaptation. Reset seed after construction and parent loading. Only the declared zero adapter weight may be missing from the parent.
required_gates: Exact initial ordinary-versus-zero-adapter predictions on CUDA with the real batch/sequence shape; original full-validation k4 reproduced in both arms
Finite actual-size k6 forward/backward and optimizer updates, allocated peak below 90% of actual A100 capacity
Both actual-size eight-step uninterrupted versus one-plus-seven separate-process checkpoints identical in every weight/optimizer/RNG/loader/history/contract value and per-document result
Preselected continuous prefixes only; no intermediate quality-based recipe change or early stop
stop: Stop on changed provenance, nonfinite state, failed numerical/memory/restart gate, exceeded queue deadline or exceeded four-pass corpus ceiling; preserve evidence, no automatic retraining.
limitations: Component ablation adds 1.714% parameters and per-loop matrix work; it is not parameter- or FLOP-matched and cannot isolate all causes of any gain. Development data already guided R&D, with known benchmark overlaps. A seed-zero pass warrants fresh seeds and capability/held-out confirmation, not adoption. Budget estimates and device bandwidth ceilings are not measured speed or memory.
